name: io.github.maxf98/slack
title: Slack
description: Slack's hosted MCP server: search, messages, channels and canvases.

io.github.maxf98.streamdeck-mcp/studio.scopes: search:read.public chat:write channels:history users:read users:read.email canvases:read canvases:write
notes: Pre-registered OAuth app: Slack requires a client SECRET, so the code->token exchange runs on the registry service and `exchangeProxy` tells the Studio to route its redirect through it. The secret stays a Railway env var.

The client id is a literal here because this list is published as a static file. That is not a leak: a client id is public by construction (it rides in every authorize URL) and this exact value has been served unauthenticated from /registry all along.
The scopes are USER scopes (sent as user_scope in the authorize URL) because Slack's MCP server needs a user token (xoxp-), not a bot token (xoxb-).
Note `search:read.public`, not `search:read`: the broader scope needs Slack approval the app does not have.
